subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should legacy ownerless sessions be permanently unavailable to plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` calls, or should a trusted migration or operator-adoption path assign ownership first?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the persisted upgrade and plugin-isolation contract; source inspection cannot determine the repository's desired policy for pre-ownership rows.

options.title: Fail closed on ownerless rows
options.body: Keep ownerless sessions operator-only and document and prove the supported recovery path.

options.title: Add trusted ownership adoption
options.body: Provide an explicit doctor or operator workflow that assigns a verified plugin owner before plugin-runtime access is allowed.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on ownerless rows
recommendation.body: Keep ownerless sessions operator-only and document and prove the supported recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh introduced the patch projection seam and led the SQLite session-storage cutover that defines this authorization boundary.
